arguments.name: relationshipCode
arguments.description:
Use this to identify the relationship record by code (recommended).
Performs an exact match against the results grid and selects that record for editing.

raw.name: relationshipCode
raw.description:
Use this to identify the relationship record by code (recommended).
Performs an exact match against the results grid and selects that record for editing.

arguments.name: relationshipName
arguments.description:
Use this to identify the relationship record by its name when code is not available.
Matches case-insensitive exact name; if multiple matches occur, the tool returns an AMBIGUOUS response instead of updating the wrong record.  (e.g., "Spouse").

raw.name: relationshipName
raw.description:
Use this to identify the relationship record by its name when code is not available.
Matches case-insensitive exact name; if multiple matches occur, the tool returns an AMBIGUOUS response instead of updating the wrong record.  (e.g., "Spouse").

arguments.name: newRelationshipName
arguments.description:
New name to save into ctl00$body$txtName (max 20 chars).
If not provided, the tool will not update anything and the relationship name will remain unchanged.

raw.name: newRelationshipName
raw.description:
New name to save into ctl00$body$txtName (max 20 chars).
If not provided, the tool will not update anything and the relationship name will remain unchanged.
